visual_review.native_light_dark: Reviewed at 48px and enlarged; clear silhouette, consistent strokes, smooth curves and legible intended subject.
visual_review.original_current_comparison: The rejected central flag is just a short bar and the towers have cramped roof-to-wall proportions.
visual_review.changes: Raised a longer flagstaff with a turned pennant edge, staggered the three roofs and preserved the clear central doorway.
visual_review.construction_reference: Lucide castle original/atomic-debug for coherent wall and doorway construction; original supplies the three pointed towers.

omissions: Two side flags omitted and the central pennant simplified to an open turned edge; three roofed towers and doorway retained.
